audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 with 49.23% over 776 games and an all-Vex chart fits a kit built to punish dashes against a champion whose exit is a dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes is the generic "full kit at 3 / level 6 adds the zone / Luden's" template.
audit.why: Her level 6 is Shadow Surge, a mark from 2000/2500/3000 with a recast dash at 140/120/100s — that is the spike that matters here.

The decisive interactions are stated correctly: Doom 'n Gloom (P) is the fear, it rides her next basic ability and interrupts dashes, and any dash near her leaves a mark that both damages and shortens her fear timer; Personal Space (W) is the 16/15/14/13/12s shield that eats your burst; Mistral Bolt reaches 1200 against your 900. report[5].t, spikes[0].text and mid all name them.
Vex is female; the owner is addressed as "you", so the third-person pronoun is hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late and dontsFull[1].d are enemy-agnostic templates.
audit.why: Each has a Vex-specific fact available: the 1200-vs-900 range gap, the 8s Mistral Bolt whiff window, holding Between Worlds until after Shadow Surge lands, and her 475-range shield.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten at the same length.
